motion_and_interactions.spring_physics: stiffness 300, damping 25 for modal overlays and drawer sheets
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap animations in @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) or motion.div with conditional duration: 0

accessibility_requirements.contrast: All text strictly meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio against their background surfaces
accessibility_requirements.data_testid: Every interactive button, input, table row, tab trigger, and status badge MUST have kebab-case data-testid (e.g. data-testid='chat-send-button', data-testid='deposit-status-badge')
accessibility_requirements.keyboard_nav: Focus-visible rings with ring-2 ring-offset-2 ring-sky-500 on all interactive components

instructions_to_main_agent: Always display the official brand logo 'talksme.in' from the provided asset URL in the header and login screens.
Use the brand gradient (Cyan #06B6D4 to Royal Blue #3B82F6 to Violet #8B5CF6) for CTA buttons, hero badges, and active state indicators.
Provide seamless Light and Dark mode using the predefined surface tokens in globals/index.css.
Implement all 4 roles with a quick 1-click demo switcher at /demo and in the top navigation bar for effortless testing.
Prominently mark simulated integrations (Audio Calls, Stripe/Razorpay Billing, Webhook Engine, Custom Domains) with the MOCKED label badge.
Ensure all deposit ledger actions (Recorded, Reviewed, Disputed, Reversed) update real backend state with immutable audit records.
Build the 3-pane WhatsApp Web-style inbox with full responsive collapse for mobile/tablet viewports.
